note: 僅族語模式顯示的羅馬拼音在原型中為教學草稿，須於 Phase C 與族語協作者校訂後再視為正式文本。

yayo.zh: 海風從開元港那邊吹過來。椰油的店家與灘頭還是這麼熱鬧——歡迎回家。
yayo.en: The sea breeze blows in from Kaiyuan Harbour. The shops and boat beach of Yayo are as lively as ever — welcome home.
yayo.tao: Yayo — pongso no Tao. (教學草稿)

iraraley.zh: 朗島的路很寬，潮間帶也很大。長輩說，從前東清和椰油的人路過這裡，總會跟人打招呼。
iraraley.en: The roads of Iraraley are wide, and the tide flats are huge. The elders say people from Iranmeylek and Yayo always stopped to say hello when passing through.

iranmeylek.zh: 東清灣的清晨來得特別早。傳說這裡是天神下凡的地方；今天，飛魚的海就在眼前。
iranmeylek.en: Morning comes early to Dongqing Bay. Legend says the gods came down here. Today, the flying fish sea is right in front of you.

ivalino.zh: 野銀還保留著最完整的地下屋聚落。石牆與水芋田就在部落旁邊，生活的樣子還攤在眼前。
ivalino.en: Ivalino keeps the most complete village of semi-underground houses. The stone walls and taro fields sit right beside it — daily life, out in the open.

imorod.zh: 紅頭是飛魚傳說開始的地方。衛生所、郵局、八代灣與南方的小蘭嶼，都從這裡望出去。
imorod.en: Imorod is where the flying fish legend began. The health station, the post office, Badai Bay and Little Orchid Island to the south — you see them all from here.

iratay.zh: 漁人的腹地雖小，卻是島上最平坦的出海口。跑道的風聲裡，有人回來，也有人剛到。
iratay.en: Iratay has little flat land, but it's the island's flattest place to launch to sea. In the wind off the runway, some come home and some just arrive.

visitor.zh: 船靠上開元港。請記得：拼板舟、地下屋與曬魚架都是族人的生活與財產，靠近前先問一聲。歡迎以訪客的身分好好聽、好好走。
visitor.en: The boat pulls into Kaiyuan Harbour. Please remember: plank boats, underground houses and fish-drying racks are the Tao people's life and property. Ask before you go near. Welcome — listen well and walk gently as a visitor.
visitor.tao: Pongso no Tao. Maran kamo. (教學草稿)
visitor.taoEn: Pongso no Tao. Maran kamo. (teaching draft)

lines.zh: 來得好。先把這幾個詞放進手札：這座島叫 Pongso no Tao，人之島。
lines.en: Good to see you. Put these words in your notebook first: this island is Pongso no Tao, the Island of People.

lines.zh: 招魚祭是 meyvanwa，飛魚季叫 rayon，飛魚是 alibangbang。我們的小船叫 tatala，水芋是 soli，種水芋的田有人稱為 alibaong。
lines.en: The fish-calling festival is meyvanwa, the flying fish season is rayon, and flying fish is alibangbang. Our small boat is a tatala, taro is soli, and some call the taro field alibaong.
lines.tao: meyvanwa · rayon · alibangbang · tatala · soli · alibaong

lines.zh: 寫族語的時候，記得那個小小的「’」——它是喉塞音，是一個字母，不是重音。ng 是一個鼻音，像 mangay「去」；要分開念 n 和 g 就寫 man-gamo。重音不在最後一個音節時，書上會標 í、á、é、ó。
lines.en: When you write Tao, remember the little "’" — it's a glottal stop and a letter of its own, not an accent. ng is one nasal sound, as in mangay "go"; to say n and g apart, write man-gamo. When the stress isn't on the last syllable, books mark it í, á, é, ó.
lines.tao: ’ · mangay · man-gamo · í á é ó

lines.zh: 這些不只是「單字」。飛魚是海神的禮物，怎麼捕、怎麼煮、何時停，都是對祂的禮。想再多聽，就到田裡、港口和衛生所走走吧。
lines.en: These aren't just "words". Flying fish are a gift from the sea god. How we catch them, cook them and when we stop are all ways of showing respect. To hear more, walk around the fields, the harbour and the health station.

lines.zh: 歡迎到蘭嶼衛生所。我可以從營養學跟你說一說「飛魚與水芋」為什麼常一起出現在桌上。
lines.en: Welcome to the Lanyu Health Station. I can tell you, from a nutrition view, why flying fish and taro are so often on the table together.

lines.zh: 飛魚（alibangbang）提供優質蛋白質、Omega-3 脂肪酸與維生素 D；水芋（soli）是溫和的複合碳水、膳食纖維與鉀。划舟、下田，正好需要這樣的搭配。
lines.en: Flying fish (alibangbang) give good protein, omega-3 fats and vitamin D. Taro (soli) gives gentle complex carbs, fibre and potassium. Just right for paddling and field work.

lines.zh: 傳統上，飛魚有自己的烹煮規範，不要和某些食物混煮——這是文化裡的飲食禮，也是長輩的提醒。營養說明是補充，不是要取代這個禮。
lines.en: By tradition, flying fish have their own cooking rules and aren't cooked with certain foods. It's a food custom and an elders' reminder. Nutrition facts add to that custom; they don't replace it.
lines.tao: yakanan no among no rayon  (教學草稿)
lines.taoEn: yakanan no among no rayon  (teaching draft)

lines.zh: 梯田的水很涼。趁節奏對了，輕輕採收一株水芋。請只體驗教學田，不要走進別人的田埂。
lines.en: The terraced water is cool. When the rhythm is right, gently pull up one taro. Only use the teaching field — please don't walk on other people's field banks.

lines.zh: 現在是飛魚季 rayon。這是教學用的時機練習，只在這一處體驗點；真正的漁團與火把，是族人自己的事。看準飛魚躍出的瞬間再出手。
lines.en: It's flying fish season, rayon. This is a timing practice for learning, only at this one spot. The real fishing crews and torches belong to the Tao people. Wait for the moment a flying fish leaps, then go.

lines.zh: 今夜與清晨屬於招魚祭 meyvanwa。先學會名字、學會等待。教學捕魚請改到飛魚季再來。
lines.en: Tonight and early morning belong to the fish-calling festival, meyvanwa. First learn the names, and learn to wait. Come back in flying fish season for the practice fishing.

lines.zh: 現在不是捕飛魚的時候。終食祭之後，飛魚不再被食用；休漁期改作其他漁法。尊重季節，也是尊重飛魚。
lines.en: It's not the time to catch flying fish. After the end-of-eating festival, flying fish are no longer eaten, and the off-season uses other kinds of fishing. Respecting the season is respecting the flying fish.

lines.zh: 南方那座小島是小蘭嶼 Jimagaod。傳統上，這裡和紅頭海域的漁獵、還有椰子等資源有關。改日再用 tatala 過去——現在先把名字收進手札。
lines.en: The small island to the south is Little Orchid Island, Jimagaod. Traditionally it's tied to fishing in the Imorod waters and to resources like coconuts. Another day you can go by tatala — for now, put the name in your notebook.

lines.zh: 歡迎來到開元港！船班看天氣，東北季風一來就可能停航，回程記得多留一天。
lines.en: Welcome to Kaiyuan Harbour! Boats depend on the weather. Once the northeast monsoon comes, sailings may stop, so leave an extra day for the trip back.

lines.zh: 灘頭的拼板舟是各家族的財產，拍照前先問一聲，也請不要坐上去或觸摸船眼的圖紋。
lines.en: The plank boats on the beach belong to each family. Ask before taking photos, and please don't sit in them or touch the boat-eye patterns.

lines.zh: 我在記錄潮間帶的植物——馬鞍藤、文殊蘭都長在沙灘邊。部落的人說，地下屋和涼亭 tagakal 要先打招呼再靠近。
lines.en: I'm recording the beach plants — beach morning glory and crinum lilies grow along the sand. The villagers say to greet people first before going near the underground houses and tagakal pavilions.

lines.zh: 想學族語，隨時來學校找我。
lines.en: Want to learn Tao? Come find me at the school any time.

lines.zh: 騎車慢慢來，安全第一。
lines.en: Ride slowly. Safety first.

lines.zh: 需要什麼再來看看。
lines.en: Come back if you need anything.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的時候部落灘頭不能浮潛，椰油斷層也不能潛。等季節過了再來找我。
lines.en: In flying fish season there's no snorkelling at the village beaches, and no diving at the Yayo drop-off. Come back after the season.

lines.zh: 慢慢看，慢慢學。能公開的部分我再教你們。
lines.en: Watch slowly, learn slowly. I'll teach you the parts that can be shared.

lines.zh: 想學部落家裡常煮的菜嗎？先把食材找齊，再來找我，我一步一步教你。
lines.en: Want to learn the dishes village families cook at home? Gather the ingredients first, then come to me. I'll teach you step by step.

lines.zh: 每個部落、每一家的做法不太一樣，細節還要請族人確認。
lines.en: Each village and each family does it a bit differently. The details still need checking with the Tao community.
